name: MBSF Mortality Denominator Files
description: Mortality denominator files from the Master Beneficiary Summary File (MBSF). The dataset provides detailed demographic and enrollment information for all Medicare beneficiaries above the age of 65.

license.name: No license, user must be under Data User Agreement (DUA)

content.age_dob: Int64: Age based on date of birth
content.hmo_indicators: List[String]: Health Maintenance Organization (HMO) enrollment indicators
content.dual: Int64: Dual eligibility status for Medicare and Medicaid
content.orec: Int64: Original reason for Medicare entitlement

name: Yearly ZCTA-Level Counts
description: Yearly mortality and demographic summaries at the ZCTA level, including beneficiary counts, death counts, and age, sex, race, and dual enrollment distributions.

content.n_bene: Int64: Number of beneficiaries in ZCTA
content.n_dead: Float64: Number of deaths in ZCTA in given year
content.female_pct: Float64: Percent of beneficiaries that are female
content.dual_pct: Float64: Percent of beneficiaries with dual Medicaid enrollment
content.age_65_75_pct: Float64: Percent of beneficiaries with age [65, 75]
content.age_76_85_pct: Float64: Percent of beneficiaries with age (76, 85]
content.age_86_95_pct: Float64: Percent of beneficiaries with age (86, 95]
content.age_96_105_pct: Float64: Percent of beneficiaries with age (96, 105]
content.age_106_115_pct: Float64: Percent of beneficiaries with age (106,115]
content.race_black_pct: Float64: Percent of Black or African American beneficiaries
content.race_hispanic_pct: Float64: Percent of Hispanic or Latino beneficiaries
content.race_asian_pct: Float64: Percent of Asian or Asian American beneficiaries

name: Yearly ZCTA-Level Stratified Counts
description: Yearly ZCTA-level counts stratified by age group, sex, race, and dual eligibility.

content.age_grp: String: Age group of the beneficiary
content.dual: Int32: Dual eligibility status for Medicare and Medicaid
content.n_bene: Int64: Number of unique beneficiaries stratified by year, zcta, age_grp, sex, race, and dual.

name: Daily ZCTA-Level Mortality Counts
description: Daily ZIP Code Tabulation Area (ZCTA)-level mortality dataset containing the number of deaths recorded each day, within a specific ZCTA.

content.date: Date32[day]: Specific calendar day of the recorded deaths
content.n_dead: Int64: Number of deaths on the given date in the specified ZCTA

content.date: Timestamp: The specific calendar day on which the deaths occurred
content.age_grp: String: Age group of the beneficiary
content.dual: Double: Dual eligibility status for Medicare and Medicaid
content.n_dead: Int64: The number of Medicare beneficiaries who died within the specified demographic group, zcta, and time period

name: Yearly County-Level Counts
description: Yearly mortality and demographic statistics aggregated at the county level, including death counts and population characteristics of Medicare beneficiaries.

content.n_bene: Int64: Number of beneficiaries in County
content.n_dead: Int64: Number of deaths in County in given year
content.female_pct: Float64: Percent of beneficiaries that are female
content.dual_pct: Float64: Percent of beneficiaries with dual Medicaid enrollment
content.age_65_75_pct: Float64: Percent of beneficiaries with age [65, 75]
content.age_76_85_pct: Float64: Percent of beneficiaries with age (75, 85]
content.age_86_95_pct: Float64: Percent of beneficiaries with age (85, 95]
content.age_96_105_pct: Float64: Percent of beneficiaries with age (96, 105]
content.age_106_115_pct: Float64: Percent of beneficiaries with age (106,115]
content.race_black_pct: Float64: Percent of Black or African American beneficiaries
content.race_hispanic_pct: Float64: Percent of Hispanic or Latino beneficiaries
content.race_asian_pct: Float64: Percent of Asian or Asian American beneficiaries

name: Yearly County-Level Stratified Counts
description: Yearly county-level Medicare mortality dataset stratified by demographics and dual eligibility.

content.age_grp: String: Age group of the beneficiary
content.dual: Double: Dual eligibility status for Medicare and Medicaid
content.n_bene: Int64: Number of beneficiaries stratified by year, county, age_grp, sex, race, and dual

name: Daily county-level mortality data
description: Daily county-level mortality dataset, including the number of deaths recorded in each county.

content.date: Date32[day]: The specific calendar day on which the deaths occurred
content.n_dead: Int64: Number of deaths in the specified county on a given date

name: Daily County-Level Stratified Counts
description: Sparse, daily county-level Medicare mortality dataset stratified by demographics and dual eligibility.

content.date: Timestamp: The specific calendar day on which the deaths occurred
content.age_grp: String: Age group of the beneficiary
content.dual: Double: Dual eligibility status for Medicare and Medicaid
content.n_dead: Int64: The number of Medicare beneficiaries who died within the specified demographic group, county, and time period
